component.name: ISPConfig MCP Server
component.summary: MCP server for the ISPConfig 3 hosting control panel

description.p: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI assistants manage ISPConfig 3 through its remote API.

ul.li: DNS zones and records, mail domains and mailboxes
Websites, databases, FTP and shell users, cron jobs and clients
Configuration migration between two ISPConfig instances
Read-only mode that disables data-modifying tools
